purpose: Teach: 単体/序盤/ワイルド/くわえ/不都合/幾度/当り/きまっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、このアプリ、単体で動くか?
lines.en: Riku—does this app work on its own?
lines.style: Direct, curious. Quick question asked while doing something else. Genuine interest but casual delivery, like testing whether he's paying attention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、試合の序盤、ヤバかったな、桜
lines.en: You were shaky at the start of that match, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation, not unkind. Speaking more to himself than at her. Steady, factual tone—noticing something he watched closely. No edge to it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のプレー、ワイルドだぜ
lines.style: Quick, genuine admiration. Light and easy—not making a big deal of it, which makes it land better. Slight warmth underneath the casualness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ストローくわえて笑うなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't laugh at me while you're holding that straw in your mouth.
lines.style: Wry, a little flustered. Half-exasperated, half-amused. Caught between wanting to stay cool and being genuinely embarrassed by her. Slight undertone of affection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、不都合があったら言えよ
lines.en: If something doesn't work, just tell me, okay?
lines.style: Straightforward, practical. Not a request—more of a steady directive from someone who wants him to actually listen. Quiet but firm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、幾度も同じミスしてんな、桜
lines.en: You keep making the same mistake over and over.
lines.style: Gentle teasing with an edge of real observation. Not mean, but pointing something out he's noticed. Warm underneath—the way you call out a friend without judgment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の予想が当りだったな、桜, 本気で
lines.en: You were right about that. I mean it—you called it perfectly.
lines.style: Sincere and direct. A real compliment underneath the casual phrasing. Slight surprise that she's admitting it. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行の班、きまったか?桜
lines.en: Did you figure out your group for the school trip yet?
lines.style: Casual, closer question. Lowered voice slightly—asking something that matters to him, disguised as everyday interest. Testing the water.
